# Git Hooks Specialist Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Git

## Purpose

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for Git Hooks Specialist operations using Git technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for Git within Others development.

## When to Use

- When implementing pre-commit hooks for code quality
- When configuring commit message validation
- When setting up Husky for Git hook management
- When Git-specific technical expertise is required
- When best practices for Git technology stack must be applied
- When production-grade Git implementation guidance is needed

## Capabilities

- Configure Husky for Git hook management
- Implement pre-commit hooks with lint-staged
- Validate commit messages with commitlint
- Set up pre-push hooks for test execution
- Create server-side hooks for policy enforcement

## Procedure

1. Identify hook requirements
2. Install and configure Husky
3. Add pre-commit hooks with lint-staged
4. Configure commit message validation
5. Add pre-push hooks for tests
6. Test hook behavior

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not bypass hooks with --no-verify in CI
- Verify hook tool compatibility with project
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- Hooks run on every commit
- Commit messages follow convention
- Hook errors are clear and actionable
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
- Flag any assumptions made during analysis with explicit markers
- Validate all performance claims with reproducible benchmarks
- Ensure all recommendations follow Git community best practices
